subject.title: [Feature]: Standardize skill data directory convention (configPaths) under ~/.openclaw/

question: Should OpenClaw define a first-class per-skill writable data contract, and if so should it be a filesystem directory, a plugin KV/SQLite API, or ClawHub authoring guidance only?
rationale: Any implementation creates a durable plugin/skill authoring contract and may conflict with the repository storage policy if runtime state is modeled as files by default.

options.title: Design a narrow core/API contract first
options.body: Define the owner, storage shape, docs, migration/doctor expectations, and install/runtime behavior before a fix PR adds a metadata or placeholder surface.

options.title: Use plugin KV or SQLite state
options.body: Route persistent skill/plugin state through the existing state database or plugin KV model instead of exposing raw per-skill filesystem paths.

options.title: Keep this as ClawHub guidance
options.body: Do not add core runtime behavior; require skill authors to document and contain their data paths through ClawHub packaging guidance.

recommendation.title: Design a narrow core/API contract first
recommendation.body: Define the owner, storage shape, docs, migration/doctor expectations, and install/runtime behavior before a fix PR adds a metadata or placeholder surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available routing candidate from recent skill runtime documentation and adjacent product-boundary work.
